description: This file defines the AppPrefs class, which provides singleton-based methods for persisting minimal user preferences such as last username and login status using SharedPreferences in a Flutter application.

classes.name: AppPrefs
classes.description: A utility class for managing user preference persistence related to login state and last username.

methods.name: getLastUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the last username used, returns null if none exists.

methods.name: setLastUsername
methods.description: Stores or clears the last username used.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks whether the user is currently considered logged in.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing the login flag while preserving the last username.
